title: visual-diff project profile
description: Per-project inputs for the image-to-html skill. Lives in the project (default .visual-diff.config.json), never in the skill.

mockup.description: Path to the reference mockup PNG, relative to where vdiff.py is run.

viewport.description: CSS viewport and the device scale the mockup was exported at. Candidate render geometry is derived as mockup_px / scale.

ignore.description: Rectangles [x0,y0,x1,y1] in mockup px to mask before comparing (cursors, timestamps, other dynamic artefacts).

thresholds.description: Pass/fail gate. Trust per-region (cellSsim) over global (minSsim) — a page of whitespace scores high globally even with real defects.

regions.description: Named boxes {name:[x0,y0,x1,y1]} in mockup px for the --color sweep (per-region RGB/tint deltas).

textBoxes.description: Named boxes {name:[x0,y0,x1,y1]} in mockup px for --measure (tight glyph height/width, for matching font sizes).
